notes: Strip a: x 0-2550 plus ~300 px overlap (to 2850). Plate is NOT north-up in a simple way: Reading Road runs diagonally along the plate's west edge, curving (slope ~0.37 at top, ~0.62 from y 4250 down). Reading Road's west side is the plate edge; streets on its far side appear only as small tabs with partly cut-off names (recorded as '?' T junctions on Reading Road's centreline). Tabs carrying only sewer/water-pipe text were not recorded as streets: at y~2500, ~3000, ~4250(none) and ~4780 (text 'SEWER / SEWER / ..PE', no name). Suffixes: Lexington, Hutchins, Windham, Cleveland, Blair printed without a visible suffix in this strip; recorded as Avenue (Rockdale's tab prints ..E AVE). Fredonia Avenue: printed 'AVE.' south of Ridgeway and 'FREDONIA' south of Whittier; addresses continuous, so one street. Whittier: E-W from Reading to Fredonia plus a N-S branch (also printed WHITTIER ST.) from the corner at x~1705 south to Wehrman. Railroads (curving tracks crossing Fredonia ~y 4550 and Whittier ~x 2120), subdivision boundaries (Beech Grove, Thos. French's, Beresford's, Milton, Ellman's, Wright's) are not streets. Windham Avenue ends at the city park around x~2930 (outside this strip).
